_about: Retrieval eval set for the memory engine, built 2026-10-26 from the live memory_items rows in fixtures/memory_items_2026-10-26.json and the real user messages in `conversations`. Each case is one chat turn: the engine runs fetch_memories_for_turn(user, companion, relationship_type, query) and then selectMemories() exactly as chat-turn does. `user`/`companion` are aliases from the fixture's `actors`. Expectation keys: include (every id must be selected), include_any (at least one), exclude (none may be selected), exclude_users (no selected row may belong to that user alias), no_relevant (no selected row may have relevance >= minRelevance), max_relevant (at most N selected rows with relevance >= minRelevance), max_dupes (at most N loose near-duplicate pairs among selected facts), rank_before ([a,b]: a must be selected and rank above b whenever b is selected). Ids may be facts or threads. `previous_user_message` reproduces chat-turn's short-reply rule (queries under 6 words are prefixed with the previous user message).
selection_note: Scored against the v3 engine (branch claude/wonderful-mccarthy-gujuq1, commit 05b4dab), which is what the live database runs: DEFAULT_FACT_SELECTION minRelevance 0.2, 12 items, 900 tokens, 5 background slots; threads 0.2 / 4 / 300 / 2.
